x-2022.title: X
x-2022.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.
x-2022.overview: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.

x2xmenunited-2003.title: X2
x2xmenunited-2003.tagline: The time has come for those who are different to stand united.
x2xmenunited-2003.overview: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join their usual nemeses—Magneto and Mystique—to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

xenia.title: Xenia
xenia.overview: Strangers in their own birthplace, 16-year-old Danny and 18-year-old Odysseus cross the entire country in search of their Greek father, after their Albanian mother passes away.

xeno-2025.title: Xeno
xeno-2025.overview: A teenage girl develops an otherworldly bond with an alien after it crash-lands in the desert. As government agents close in, she must protect her new friend, while uncovering a secret that could change the fate of both their worlds.

xgames3dthemovie.title: X Games 3D: The Movie
xgames3dthemovie.overview: Follows six extreme sports stars as they prepare for and then compete in the 2008 Summer X-Games in Los Angeles. Kyle Loza practices a new motocross trick, landing in a pit of foam. Can he do it in front of thousands and land safely on dirt? Travis Pastrana shifts from a bike to a rally car - in part because he's broken so many bones. Shaun White finishes his snowboard season and jumps immediately onto his skateboard. Retired motocross champion Ricky Cunningham takes up a new event. In the finale, after practicing together as friends and competitors, Bob Burnquist and Danny Way face off on the mega ramp

xiuxiuthesentdowngirl.title: Xiu Xiu: The Sent-Down Girl
xiuxiuthesentdowngirl.overview: Young teen girl Xiu Xiu is sent away to a remote corner of the Sichuan steppes for manual labor in 1975 (sending young people to there was a part of Cultural Revolution in China). A year later, she agrees to go to even more remote spot with a Tibetan saddle tramp Lao Jin to learn horse herding.

xmen-2000.title: X-Men: The Mutant Watch
xmen-2000.overview: While Senator Kelly addresses a senate committee about the supposed mutant menace, we learn about the making of the movie, X-Men (2000)

xmenapocalypse-2016.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
xmenapocalypse-2016.overview: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

xmendaysoffuturepast.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
xmendaysoffuturepast.tagline: To save the future, they must alter the past.
xmendaysoffuturepast.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

xmenfirstclass.title: X-Men: First Class
xmenfirstclass.tagline: Witness the moment that will change our world.
xmenfirstclass.overview: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

xmenoriginswolverine.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
xmenoriginswolverine.overview: After seeking to live a normal life, Logan sets out to avenge the death of his girlfriend by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

xmenthelaststand.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
xmenthelaststand.overview: When a cure is found to treat mutations, lines are drawn amongst the X-Men—led by Professor Charles Xavier—and the Brotherhood, a band of powerful mutants organised under Xavier's former ally, Magneto.

xx-2016.title: Arena XX
xx-2016.overview: Material entitled “XX” was filmed and recorded during the Polish leg of our 20th Anniversary Tour, shortly after the release of our 8th studio album “The Unquiet Sky”.  The show was filmed at Katowice’s Kinoteatr “Rialto.  “XX” is scheduled for a worldwide release on February, 12th 2016 via Metal Mind Productions  Tracks  1. The Demon Strikes  2. Rapture  3. Double Vision  4. Crack in the Ice  5. Moviedrome  6. How Did it Come to This?  7. Butterfly Man  8. Bedlam Fayre  9. Serenity  10. The Unquiet Sky  11. Traveller Beware  12. The City of Lanterns  13. Riding the Tide  14. Hanging Tree  15. The Tinder Box  16. Solomon  17. Don’t Forget to Breathe  18. Crying for Help 7

xxx.title: xXx
xxx.tagline: A new breed of secret agent.
xxx.overview: Xander Cage is your standard adrenaline junkie with no fear and a lousy attitude. When the US Government "recruits" him to go on a mission, he's not exactly thrilled. His mission: to gather information on an organization that may just be planning the destruction of the world, led by the nihilistic Yorgi.

xxxreturnofxandercage.title: xXx: Return of Xander Cage
xxxreturnofxandercage.tagline: There are no more patriots, just rebels and tyrants.
xxxreturnofxandercage.overview: Xander Cage is left for dead after an incident, though he secretly returns to action for a new, tough assignment with his handler Augustus Gibbons.

xxxstateoftheunion.title: xXx: State of the Union
xxxstateoftheunion.overview: Darius Stone's criminal record and extreme sports obsession make him the perfect candidate to be the newest XXX agent. He must save the U.S. government from a deadly conspiracy led by five-star general and Secretary of Defense George Deckert.

xxxy.title: XX to XY: Fighting to Be Jake
xxxy.overview: Interview with "Jake" a young transgendered Brit who is undergoing the process of changing from female to male.

xxy.title: XXY
xxy.tagline: Our sex makes us men and women ...or both
xxy.overview: Alex, an intersexed 15-year-old, is living as a girl, but she and her family begin to wonder whether she's emotionally a boy when another teenager's sexual advances bring the issue to a head. As Alex faces a final decision regarding her gender, she meets both hostility and compassion.
